title: S&P 500 Earnings Yield
revision_note: Shiller periodically restates historical earnings figures; the site always shows the latest revision.
methodology: Earnings yield = trailing 12-month as-reported (GAAP) EPS / monthly average price (the reciprocal of the S&P 500 P/E ratio, expressed as a percent), both read from Shiller's ie_data.xls (columns E and P).

A month appears here once Shiller has published a confirmed TTM earnings figure for it, with no forward-fill beyond that - unlike the S&P 500 P/E chart, this series does not extend into the following quarter on a held-flat earnings assumption.
The current, not-yet-completed month is never included.
notes: Built for S9b/S10 (equity-valuation roadmap) alongside CAPE and dividend yield, all read from the same ie_data.xls download.

Not published on joemirza.com: Shiller's terms are unknown (no statement on the Yale page or shillerdata.com), and the underlying price and earnings columns are S&P's. presentation.publish is false pending an answer from shillerdata.com's maintainer (asked 2026-09-16); scripts/dev.sh builds it locally regardless.

presentation.summary: Monthly S&P 500 trailing earnings yield, Shiller/Yale data back to 1871.
